briefdescription.para: Distributed tensor retrieval planner with summary-first, exact-on-demand, graph-verified finalization.

detaileddescription.para:
Implements the core workflow:
Summary-first routing (use advisory summaries to select shards)
Exact-on-demand fragment loading (fetch actual tensor data from selected shards)
Graph-verified finalization (validate results against graph truth before output)
Enforces the "no-summary-only-truth" rule: distributed tensor summaries can never be the sole source of truth for query results. All outputs must be validated against exact graph data.
